statement.ru: Святой Николай, ставший Санта-Клаусом, жил на землях нынешней Турции.
statement.en: Saint Nicholas, who became Santa Claus, lived in what is now Turkey.

why: Born in Patara and bishop of Myra, both in modern Turkey.

statement.ru: В Библии сказано, что Иисус родился 25 декабря.
statement.en: The Bible says Jesus was born on 25 December.

why: The Gospels give no date; the church fixed 25 December in the 4th century.

statement.ru: Финского Санта-Клауса зовут «Рождественский козёл».
statement.en: The Finnish Santa Claus is called the 'Christmas goat'.

why: Joulupukki literally means 'Christmas goat' or 'Yule goat'.

statement.ru: Слово «Хеллоуин» означает «ночь ведьм».
statement.en: The word 'Halloween' means 'night of the witches'.

why: It is a contraction of All Hallows' Eve, the evening before All Saints' Day.

statement.ru: Ёлочный дождик сначала делали из настоящего серебра.
statement.en: Christmas tinsel was first made of real silver.

why: Tinsel was originally made from extruded strands of silver.

statement.ru: Пасхального зайца придумали американские производители шоколада.
statement.en: The Easter Bunny was invented by American chocolate makers.

why: The Easter Hare comes from German Lutheran custom, attested in the 1600s.

statement.ru: У Санта-Клауса есть настоящий канадский почтовый индекс — H0H 0H0.
statement.en: Santa Claus has a real Canadian postal code: H0H 0H0.

why: Canada Post answers letters addressed to Santa Claus, North Pole, H0H 0H0.

statement.ru: Красноносого оленя Рудольфа придумали ещё в Средние века.
statement.en: Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer was made up back in the Middle Ages.

why: Robert L. May created Rudolph in 1939 for the Montgomery Ward department store.

statement.ru: Искусственные ёлки из щетины придумала фирма, делавшая ёршики для унитаза.
statement.en: Bristle artificial Christmas trees were invented by a toilet brush company.

why: Addis made them in 1930 with the same bristles and technology as its toilet brushes.

statement.ru: «X» в слове Xmas — греческая буква, первая в слове «Христос».
statement.en: The 'X' in Xmas is the Greek letter that starts the word 'Christ'.

why: X is the Greek chi, first letter of Christós.

statement.ru: Китайский Новый год празднуют один день.
statement.en: Chinese New Year is celebrated for just one day.

why: The festival runs from New Year's Eve to the Lantern Festival on the 15th day.

statement.ru: Омела, под которой целуются на Рождество, — растение-паразит.
statement.en: The mistletoe people kiss under at Christmas is a parasitic plant.

why: Mistletoes are hemiparasites that draw water and nutrients from a host tree.

statement.ru: Валентинки придумали открыточные фабрики в XX веке.
statement.en: Valentine cards were invented by card companies in the 20th century.

why: The oldest surviving valentine dates from the 1400s; sending valentine cards was common in 18th-century England.

statement.ru: На Хеллоуин играют в игру: ловить зубами яблоки в тазу с водой.
statement.en: At Halloween people play a game of catching apples in a tub of water with their teeth.

why: Apple bobbing is a common Halloween game in Ireland and Britain.

statement.ru: Остров Пасхи так назвали, потому что европейцы открыли его в Пасху.
statement.en: Easter Island got its name because Europeans found it on Easter Day.

why: Roggeveen reached it on Easter Sunday 1722.

statement.ru: В Японии на День святого Валентина шоколад дарят в основном женщины.
statement.en: In Japan, it's mostly women who give chocolate on Valentine's Day.

why: Women give chocolate to men on 14 February; men give back on White Day, 14 March.

statement.ru: Обычай ставить свечи на торт в день рождения придумали в США.
statement.en: The custom of candles on a birthday cake was invented in the USA.

why: A cake with a candle for each year is recorded in Germany in 1746.

statement.ru: Святой Валентин считается покровителем пчеловодов.
statement.en: Saint Valentine is a patron saint of beekeepers.

why: He is patron saint of Terni, epilepsy and beekeepers.

statement.ru: В Бразилии Новый год принято встречать в чёрном.
statement.en: In Brazil, people usually see in the New Year dressed in black.

why: Brazilians wear white on New Year's Eve, a custom from honouring Iemanjá.

statement.ru: Китайский Новый год вызывает самую большую ежегодную миграцию людей в мире.
statement.en: Chinese New Year causes the largest yearly human migration in the world.

why: Chunyun has been called the largest annual human migration in the world.

statement.ru: День подарков в Британии, Boxing Day, назван в честь бокса.
statement.en: Britain's Boxing Day is named after the sport of boxing.

why: The name comes from Christmas boxes of money and gifts.

statement.ru: Во вьетнамском гороскопе вместо Кролика — Кот.
statement.en: The Vietnamese zodiac has the Cat instead of the Rabbit.

why: The Vietnamese zodiac replaces the rabbit with the cat.

statement.ru: Ёлку, которую продают к празднику, выращивают около года.
statement.en: A Christmas tree sold for the holidays takes about a year to grow.

why: It takes about six to ten years to grow a tree to sale size.

statement.ru: Наряжать ёлку в Британии стало модно благодаря немецкому мужу королевы Виктории.
statement.en: Decorating a Christmas tree became fashionable in Britain thanks to Queen Victoria's German husband.

why: Prince Albert's family tree, shown in the Illustrated London News in 1848, spread the custom.

statement.ru: Святой Патрик, покровитель Ирландии, был ирландцем.
statement.en: Saint Patrick, the patron saint of Ireland, was Irish.

why: He was born in Roman Britain and taken to Ireland as a slave.

statement.ru: У британского монарха два дня рождения в году: настоящий и официальный.
statement.en: The British monarch has two birthdays a year: a real one and an official one.

why: The King's Official Birthday is a separate fixed day.

statement.ru: Шотландцы верят: к удаче, если первой в Новом году в дом войдёт блондинка.
statement.en: Scots believe it's lucky if a blonde woman is first through the door in the New Year.

why: The lucky first-footer is a tall dark man; women and fair-haired men are thought unlucky.

statement.ru: В Корее раньше все прибавляли год к возрасту в один день — на Новый год.
statement.en: In Korea everyone used to add a year to their age on the same day: New Year's.

why: Under the traditional system everyone gained a year on New Year's Day, until 2023.

statement.ru: Канада празднует День благодарения в тот же день, что и США.
statement.en: Canada celebrates Thanksgiving on the same day as the USA.

why: Canada's is the second Monday in October; the US one is in late November.

statement.ru: В 1957 году BBC показала репортаж о сборе спагетти с деревьев.
statement.en: In 1957 the BBC showed a report about harvesting spaghetti from trees.

why: An April Fools' report on Panorama; hundreds of viewers asked how to grow spaghetti.

statement.ru: Карнавал в Рио проходит в новогоднюю ночь.
statement.en: The Rio Carnival takes place on New Year's Eve.

why: It is held in the days before Lent, in February or March.

statement.ru: Во Франции 1 апреля приклеивают людям на спину бумажную рыбку.
statement.en: In France on 1 April, people stick a paper fish on someone's back.

why: The French call it poisson d'avril, the April fish.

statement.ru: На индийском празднике Холи бросаются помидорами.
statement.en: At the Indian festival of Holi, people throw tomatoes at each other.

why: People throw coloured powder and coloured water.

statement.ru: Burger King в шутку объявил о Воппере для левшей.
statement.en: Burger King once announced a Whopper for left-handers as a joke.

why: A 1998 April Fools' ad: the toppings were rotated 180° for left-handers.

statement.ru: Самый продаваемый сингл в истории — рождественская песня.
statement.en: The best-selling single in history is a Christmas song.

why: Bing Crosby's White Christmas, over 50 million copies.

statement.ru: Индейку по-английски зовут turkey, потому что она родом из Турции.
statement.en: The turkey is called 'turkey' in English because it comes from Turkey.

why: Turkeys are native to the Americas; the name first belonged to guineafowl imported via Turkey.

statement.ru: Голландский Синтерклас приезжает с Северного полюса на оленях.
statement.en: The Dutch Sinterklaas arrives from the North Pole on reindeer.

why: He arrives by steamboat from Spain and rides a white horse.

statement.ru: В Японии в новогоднюю ночь в храмах бьют в колокол 108 раз.
statement.en: In Japan on New Year's Eve, temple bells are struck 108 times.

why: Buddhist temples ring their bells 108 times at midnight.
